spots.name: 故宫
spots.intro: 故宫是中国明清两代的皇家宫殿，旧称紫禁城，位于北京中轴线中心，是世界上现存规模最大、保存最完整的木质结构古建筑群。
spots.history: 故宫始建于明永乐四年（1406年），历时十四年建成，明清两代共有二十四位皇帝在此居住和理政。1925年成立故宫博物院，1987年被列入《世界遗产名录》。
spots.narrate: 故宫，又称紫禁城，位于北京市东城区，是中国明清两代的皇家宫殿，也是世界上现存规模最大、保存最完整的木质结构古建筑群。它始建于明朝永乐年间，先后有二十四位皇帝在这里居住和理政。故宫分为外朝和内廷两部分，主要看点有太和殿、中和殿、保和殿、乾清宫，以及珍宝馆和钟表馆。参观时建议从午门进入，沿着中轴线一路游览。

en.name: The Palace Museum (Forbidden City)
en.open_info: Peak season 8:30–17:00, off-season 8:30–16:30; closed on Mondays (except public holidays)
en.intro: The Palace Museum, also known as the Forbidden City, is the imperial palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties. Located at the center of Beijing's central axis, it is the largest and best-preserved complex of wooden ancient buildings in the world.
en.history: Construction began in 1406, the fourth year of Emperor Yongle's reign, and took fourteen years to complete. Twenty-four emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties lived and ruled here. The Palace Museum was established in 1925 and was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 1987.
en.narrate: Welcome to the Palace Museum, also known as the Forbidden City. Located in the heart of Beijing, it was the imperial palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties and is the largest and best-preserved complex of wooden ancient buildings in the world. It was built in the early fifteenth century, and twenty-four emperors lived and ruled here. The palace is divided into the outer court and the inner court. Its main highlights include the Hall of Supreme Harmony, the Hall of Central Harmony, the Hall of Preserving Harmony and the Palace of Heavenly Purity, as well as the Treasures Gallery and the Clocks and Watches Gallery. Visitors are advised to enter through the Meridian Gate and follow the central axis.

spots.name: 八达岭长城
spots.intro: 八达岭长城是明长城中保存最完整、最具代表性的一段，位于北京市延庆区，是万里长城的重要组成部分。
spots.history: 八达岭长城修建于明代弘治十八年（1505年），是明代长城的精华段落。这里地势险要，自古为兵家必争之地，也是明长城中向游人开放最早的地段。
spots.narrate: 八达岭长城位于北京市延庆区，是明长城中保存最完整、最具代表性的一段。它修建于明代，地势险要，是古代重要的军事防御工程。登上长城，可以俯瞰燕山群峰，主要看点有北八楼、南四楼和好汉坡，亲身感受不到长城非好汉的豪迈。

en.name: Badaling Great Wall
en.intro: The Badaling Great Wall is the best-preserved and most representative section of the Ming Great Wall. Located in Yanqing District, Beijing, it is a key part of the Great Wall of China.
en.history: The Badaling section was built in 1505 during the Ming dynasty and is the finest part of the Ming Great Wall. Because of its strategic terrain, it was a contested military stronghold in ancient times, and it was the earliest section of the Ming Great Wall opened to visitors.
en.narrate: The Badaling Great Wall is located in Yanqing District, Beijing. It is the best-preserved and most representative section of the Ming Great Wall. Built in the Ming dynasty, it served as an important military defense with steep and strategic terrain. Standing on the wall, you can overlook the peaks of the Yanshan Mountains. Its main highlights are the North Eighth Tower, the South Fourth Tower and Hero Slope, where you can feel the spirit of the famous saying that one is not a true hero until reaching the Great Wall.

spots.name: 西湖
spots.open_info: 全天开放（部分景点需单独购票）
spots.intro: 西湖位于浙江省杭州市，是中国著名的淡水湖泊和风景名胜，以秀丽的湖光山色和众多的名胜古迹闻名于世。
spots.history: 西湖古称钱塘湖，北宋时期苏轼曾疏浚西湖并修筑苏堤。2011年，杭州西湖文化景观被列入《世界遗产名录》。
spots.narrate: 西湖位于浙江省杭州市，是中国著名的淡水湖泊。它三面环山，湖光山色秀丽，自古就有上有天堂、下有苏杭的美誉。西湖十景闻名天下，主要有苏堤春晓、断桥残雪、三潭印月，以及雷峰塔等名胜。2011年，西湖文化景观被列入世界遗产名录。

en.name: West Lake
en.open_info: Open all day (some attractions require separate tickets)
en.intro: West Lake is a famous freshwater lake and scenic area in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, renowned for its beautiful lake and mountain scenery and many historic sites.
en.history: West Lake was called Qiantang Lake in ancient times. During the Northern Song dynasty, Su Shi dredged the lake and built the Su Causeway. In 2011, the West Lake Cultural Landscape of Hangzhou was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
en.narrate: West Lake is located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It is a famous freshwater lake in China, surrounded by mountains on three sides. Its scenery has been praised since ancient times, and the Ten Scenes of West Lake are known throughout the world, including Su Causeway in Spring Dawn, Broken Bridge in Winter Snow and Three Pools Mirroring the Moon, as well as the Leifeng Pagoda. In 2011, the West Lake Cultural Landscape was inscribed on the World Heritage List.
